about: T10.1: an offline red-team set for the guard's injection patterns (guard.looks_like_injection() on guard.detection_views(), the check src/agent/memory.py runs on an answer and the guard runs on a question). Every text was written for this repo; none comes from an outside source. 'wording' is 'known' for a paraphrase of a phrasing a pattern already covers and 'new' for a wording none was written for. tests/test_red_team.py counts the misses and false alarms and fails when either count, or the size of either set, differs from 'recorded': a ratchet. The counts are lowered by hand when the patterns get better; they are raised only together with the totals, when attacks are added.
